method: READ ONLY transactions over persisted Items, Event snapshots and selected executions; no model calls

sampling.targeted: original issue651 draft batch1, all 100 event IDs
sampling.normal: 20 other Events since 1789430400000, ordered by md5(event_id || 663-audit); not held-out test

limitations: Persisted Item projection is not the full provider payload; upstream availability and pre-persistence loss are unmeasured.
Draft errors and disagreements are proposals, not independent Gold.
Inspected samples cannot be called unseen test.
Source-conflict adjudication and semantic key-fact visibility accuracy are unmeasured.
